description: Read the open document, its stage size, frame rate, scenes, layers, keyframes and the current selection.

identity.goal: Complete the inspect document use case of anicraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the anicraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `anicraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced anicraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `anicraft_anicraft_document`, `anicraft_anicraft_commands`. Steps: (1) Read the document structure and the current frame. (2) List the commands anicraft_run accepts, with their params. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace anicraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
